name: IRLZ44N
description: Logic-level N-channel HEXFET power MOSFET in TO-220, 55V / 47A. Sub-2V threshold and Rds(on) specified at Vgs=5V let it be driven directly from 5V (and often 3.3V) microcontroller logic without a gate driver. Switching motors, lamps, heaters, and solenoids from MCU GPIO.

pins.name: G
pins.description: gate; fully enhanced near Vgs=5V. drive through a series resistor with a gate pulldown

pins.name: D
pins.description: drain; also connected to the metal tab

extra.Rds_on: 0.025 ohm typ at Vgs=5V (0.022 ohm at Vgs=10V)

typical_application: Low-side switching of inductive/resistive loads (DC motors, solenoids, relays, LED strips, heaters) directly from 5V or 3.3V GPIO without a dedicated gate driver.
gotchas: logic-level part: fully on around Vgs=5V (Rds(on) spec'd there); at 3.3V it conducts but with higher Rds(on) and can run hot at high current
do NOT confuse with the standard-level IRFZ44N, which needs ~10V on the gate and barely turns on from 5V logic
gate is a capacitive load (Qg ~48nC); use a series gate resistor and a gate-to-source pulldown so it stays off when the driving pin floats
body diode is intrinsic but slow (trr ~80ns); add an external Schottky for hard-switched inductive loads
TO-220 tab is electrically Drain; isolate it from grounded heatsinks
